derivation: publicRoutes (1) + protectedRoutes (33) = 34 declared paths. Paths are stored with their `:params` filled in so the collector can navigate them directly.
notes: App is a HashRouter: every path below is used as `#<route>`.
Two paths are pure <Navigate> redirects and are kept in the list on purpose — the redirect target is part of the observable behaviour, and the collector records `redirected`/`finalHash` for them.
/login sits behind RedirectIfAuthenticated. With a live session it redirects to the remembered page, so it CANNOT be captured in its real form while logged in. Recorded as a known gap.
/dashboard/:id needs a real VRChat user id; the placeholder below renders the shell with no data. Re-collect once a real id is known.
/favorites/import/:kind accepts friends|worlds|avatars|groups; 'friends' chosen as the representative.
/tools/group-moderation/:groupId? has an optional param and is captured without it.

routes.note: behind RedirectIfAuthenticated — redirects when logged in; real form not capturable in this session
